goal: Assess free/local AgentDojo integration feasibility for AgentTaint

steps.note: Stock AgentDojo benchmark scripts require an LLM model (e.g. gpt-4o). No free local default model is provided by AgentDojo for full attack/defense evaluation. Running those scripts would need paid APIs or a separately configured local LLM — out of scope for this free/local milestone unless a ground-truth/no-model path is available.

conclusion: Partial coverage only: AgentDojo can be imported and suites inspected, but a fair full ASR/utility evaluation was not executed because it requires an LLM backend beyond the free/local constraint of this milestone. No synthetic AgentDojo numbers are reported. Custom AgentTaint scenarios remain the primary measured evidence.
